purpose: Record all material exposure created while validating whether archived KDreams race-detail pages can support a result-blind Historical Fast Track.
positive_findings: Archived race-detail pages retain race-date-specific PRE tables containing competition_score, S, B, nige, makuri, sashi and mark alongside identity fields.
The target race finish/result is separated behind a result/payout link rather than embedded as the target finish in the PRE table.

The same rider showed changing archived competition_score across dates, supporting non-current-value behavior: Kitamura Atsushi 77.95 on 2026-07-31, 77.29 on 2026-08-25/26 archive surfaces, and 76.70 on 2026-08-31.
Existing tools/keirin_kdreams_pre_only_parser_v1.py is designed to emit only the frozen PRE table and no result, payout, odds, forecast or narabiyoso fields.
conservative_burn_action: Because explicit prior-race finish values through 2026-08-25 were surfaced during transport validation, refresh the affinity burned-date firewall through 2026-08-25 before any new Historical Fast Track population lock.
feature_firewall: Only race_date, venue, race_no, car_no, rider identity fields, class, style, competition_score, S, B, nige, makuri, sashi and mark may be emitted by the Historical Fast Track PRE parser.
No human prediction mark, comment, narabiyoso, odds, prior-race finish, payout, settlement or target result may enter the candidate feature table.
Raw mixed-content HTML must not be committed as model evidence; only allowlist extraction plus source hash/provenance receipts may be committed.
Any target result page remains forbidden until the support gate passes and exact formula/evaluation membership are frozen.
